decisions.summary: LoopDev owns the SaaS, is its subscription seller, and initially operates from Spain.
PlatformUser.fullName/avatarUrl remain the canonical profile fields; no parallel UserProfile aggregate.

Plan approval may preserve missing operation coverage when every required operation/platform maps to explicit tasks; require implemented or approved-adapted parity before build completion, verification and publication.

actions: Completed and recorded the ten required planning audits.
Inspected shared Platform references, routes, adapters, controls, consumers and legacy flows.
Created an ordered 37-task multiplatform plan and mapped all 92 missing required operation/platform pairs to renderer tasks.
Applied the approved separation between plan approval and operation parity; added strict build, verification and release gates.
Recorded explicit user approval of the plan and preserved two ready tasks while all dependent tasks remain blocked.
Prepared the 07-build handoff without starting implementation.
